_comment: OSS per-service deploy manifest for disk-controller: the disk controller and credential broker of the Windows worker pool (deploy/providers/azure/disk-controller/README.md). Conditional service: deploy.mjs skips it unless WIN_WORKERS_ENABLED=true. Listed after portal: the controller runs in the portal's namespace and its dispatcher Ingress joins the portal's host. Before its manifests step, deploy.mjs runs the Windows worker deploy step (deploy/providers/azure/deploy-steps/win-workers.mjs), which makes the controller's TLS certificate and puts its CA where the edge and the workers trust it.
name: disk-controller
